verdict.rationale: Bland's pathway/tools docs confirm agents can call external APIs and execute webhooks mid-conversation (bland-docs-4, bland-docs-25, bland-docs-30), which supports live function calling during a call. However, no evidence describes mechanisms for avoiding dead air (e.g., filler speech, streaming partial responses) while waiting on API results. missing for 10: explicit documentation of latency-masking/filler-speech behavior during API calls, and independent/hands-on confirmation of smooth conversational flow.
